Yui is the daughter of human and a Shi (another type of demon, also described as anti-shinma in some English translations). She is also part vampire as Miyu's blood runs in her veins, as Miyu fed on her mother while pregnant with Yui. Miyu describes Yui as both her sister, her daughter, and herself. Yui has long dark hair, and looks to be about twelve or thirteen years old. Like Miyu, Yui has a tragic past and friends she had to abandon upon her awakening. Yui has the additional issue of being both hunted and supported by rival factions of Shi, who do not approve of her existence.

Also like Miyu, Yui also has a blood bonded protector, a younger shinma named Nagi. Yui's personality is much more shy and timid than Miyu's, and she is still largely naive about the world at large. Nagi is very hot headed, but is a faithful companion, allowing Yui to feed on him as she refuses to feed on humans. Yui's weapon of choice are cherry blossoms, which she can bend to her will in a variety of ways. She passes this power to Miyu upon giving up her own blood for Miyu's rebirth.

Kyuuketsu Hime Yui Senyasyo is a visual novel based on the Vampire Princess Yui manga released for the Playstation 2 console. In the game the player can choose between 4 different main female characters (only 2 of them are availables at the beginning of the game), the game got a Life bar that will decrease depending of the player choices during the game. The game features different endings depending of the player choices during the game and unlockable pictures galleries.

439841.overview:
Kyuuketsu Kitan Moonties (aka Draculius in PC) begins when Ogishima Jun, the male protagonist, suddenly finds himself face to face with a childlike maid who introduces herself as Elshlant D. Annoyance. The encounter quickly brings two monumental facts to life: the first is unequivocal proof that vampires exist; the second is revelation of Jun being the sole heir of a royal linage that rules over them. Years ago, Id Demon Brandle – Jun’s vampiric father and would be future emperor – ran from his aristocratic duties to hide among the humans, eventually falling in love with a Shinto priestess named Ogishima Yukari.

For reasons unknown, Jun’s father abandoned his mother during pregnancy, and upon this act, Yukari placed a magic seal on her unborn child, locking away the infant’s supernatural abilities. Following the tragic death of his mother four years earlier, the spell has been slowly unraveling, awakening Jun’s latent powers and allowing the vampire nation to determine his location and deliver an ultimatum: Jun would be allowed to continue his existence and assume the mantle of command over his people, but only under the guidelines of three conditions. Condition One: He would be placed under the watch of Elshlant D. Annoyance, serving as his evaluator and mentor in the ways of the vampire. Condition Two: The newly awaken Nosferatu would need to perform a deed that proved him worthy of the inheritance. Condition Three: He would take a bride from one of the noble families to ensure the continued survival of the royal bloodline. As one can imagine, Jun is quite taken aback by all this.

439842.overview: The unlikely partnership and adventures of Meguru Momoi, Miako Tachibana and their newspaper club continue with the fourth installement of the series (the lastest one in Playstation 2). Konohana 4: Yami wo Harau Inori is the fourth installment in the story-driven mystery adventure game series, featuring anime-style character art and a text-based adventure/conversation system. The game now features the all-new history mode that allows players to go back and read through past conversations and events, as well as new help and skip functions. In addition to the new "Watson" character research tool, Konohana 4 also features a number of other upgrades, not the least of which is the possibility of playing through multiple ending scenarios.

439844.overview:
PS2 love simulation game, called Kono Hareta Sora no Shita De - in English, this name becomes Beneath the Clear Sky. The game takes place in the near future where so-called "Mimic" robots work in place of humans. Playing as Reichi Kuroha, a member of a government investigation team, your job is to investigate the mysterious suicide of a Mimic -- a strange occurrence, since Mimics are not supposed to kill themselves. The game includes a number of heroines, both Mimic and human, with whom you'll get involved as the story progresses.

Starfish has put together a standard 7,140 yen package along with an 8,190 Limited Edition yen package that includes an artbook and a DVD with making-of footage.

439845.overview: Mojipittan is similar in play to the word game Scrabble. Taking turns against the computer or a human opponent, the player uses tiles with hiragana to build words, eventually building upon their opponent's tiles with words of their own. Unlike Scrabble, however, each player may place only one tile per turn as opposed to multiple tiles in the former. Tiles must be placed next to any other tile on the board, space permitting, but at least one word must be formed with each tile placed; as long as these conditions are met, a tile may be placed anywhere on the board, even if not all of the other tiles a new tile is connected to form new words.

439846.overview: Kousoku Tanigawa Shogi is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Seta Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2001.

439847.overview:
Konohana 3 - Itsuwari no kage no mukou ni: After successfully solving murders in their past excursions, Meguru Momoi, Miako Tachibana and their newspaper club have gained something of a reputation in town. As summer vacation begins, Meguru receives a call from the manager of an amusement park with a mystery at the venue. Meguro rings up the other members of the crew and the group takes a trip to the park to solve yet another murder. The junior detectives follow clues, take cues from witnesses and question them effectively in a bid to reinforce their crime solving repute.

New game features in-game include a history mode where previous conversations may be reviewed to find relevant information and an appraisal system which rates your initiative and level of decisiveness during the investigation.

439850.overview: Koushien: Konpeki no Sora is a Sports game, published by Magical Company (Mahou), which was released in Japan in 2002.

439851.overview: Kyo-no Wanko is a Strategy game, developed by Infinity and published by DigiCube, which was released in Japan in 2003.

439856.overview:
Kuusen II is the second installment in the flight combat series from Kadokawa Shoten in the Playstation 2 console. Players get to jump into the cockpit of a variety of 1940s airplanes, including Zeros and A-10s. The game features all new missions set in the thick of World War II, better plane graphics, an improved radar function, as well as better control mechanics. The creators used photographs of real planes to design the most realistic textures and make sure everything looks as authentic as possible. The game also features experimental aircraft and stealth bombers.

Fly and dogfight through the spacious skies once again in Kadokawa's followup to their 2001 flight combat simulator. Pilot up to 70 different planes including vintage WW2 craft such as the fearsome Zero with a maximum speed of 351 mph and sharp turning capability, the Grumman F6F Hellcat, Messerschmitt Bf 109, and the Boeing B29 Super Fortress which was used to bomb Japanese cities during the war. The Enola Gay which dropped the "Little Boy" A-bomb on Hiroshima was a B29 bomber. Post-WW2 planes may also be piloted such as the MiG-19 and the A-10.

439865.overview: Capcom's Kyojin no Hoshi (The Anime Super Remix) features an assortment of nine baseball mini-games and 110 cels from the original Kyojin no Hoshi animation. Successful navigation and performance in the mini-games unlock additional mini-games and sets of animation stills. Once all of the games are conquered and all of the animation unlocked, a complete narrated episode of Kyojin no Hoshi may be viewed. Consider it your trophy for fading batters with expeditious efficiency.

439870.overview:
Kyo Kara Maoh! Hajimari no Tabi: is an adventure RPG video game developed and published by Namco Bandai. The adventure part is the usual visual novel style with different choices in some parts of the adventure and the RPG part is the classic turn based RPG with choices of different attacks, defend, etc. There were two versions released. The normal game and a premium box which included a drama cd and a booklet with an original story by Takabayashi Tomo.

Yuri becomes the king of a nation where all of the citizens are demons, but they appear indistinguishable from humans. Their only distinguishing traits are their long lives and the ability to use magic. The people of the Demon Tribe are able to make a pact with an element after which they can then use magic of that element. Covenant Castle is in the capital of the Demon Kingdom. It is the residence of the demon king. The culture of The Great Demon Kingdom is very different from the Japanese culture Yuri is accustomed to, and the differences make for amusing mishaps with long ranging consequences, such as an accidental proposal of marriage.

439875.overview:
Kyo Kara Maoh! Shin Makoku no Kyuujitsu was a PS2 game released September 27, 2007. There were two versions released. The normal game and a limited box which included two figures, a script book and a drama cd.

This game picks up where the anime has left off. After Yuuri interrupted the the ambitious moves of the human states against the demon country by sealing all four magical boxes, peace was achieved. But only for short while.

Back in modern day Japan, Yuuri is oblivious of what would happen in the world where he rules as a king. Instead, he spends everyday arguing with his brother for installing dating games on his computer without his consent, and going out with his long time friend. During a trip to the zoo, he realized what he could do for his country.

439889.overview: Kou Rate Ura Mahjong Retsuden Mukoubuchi: Goburei, Last desu ne is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Pi Arts, which was released in Japan in 2007.

439909.overview:
Kyoufu Shinbun (Heisei-Han) Kaiki! Shinrei File: is based on Jiro Tsunoda’s manga Kyoufu Shinbun about a newspaper which foretells of disasters and murders but shortens the lifespan of anyone who reads it.

The story centers around a newspaper fortelling a ton of disasters and murders on it, and when someone reads it, that person's life span decreases and they die in a brutal way. The story follows a highschool boy who's teachers and friends are all being killed after having read the newspaper, and he takes it upon himself to help put an end to the devastation.

The gameplay changes between first- and third-person exploration. By the fact that the 2P controller is inserted in the substance, protection spirit resides in the controller. Without the times when no one controller where protection spirit resides informs about the danger of approaching to the prayer touches, with a some technique.

441233.overview: Kyoushuu Kidou Butai: Kougeki Helicopter Senki is an Action game, developed by ASK and published by Taito Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2004. The North American release was to be titled Threat Con Delta but was canceled.

441256.overview: Kung Fu Fighting was pitched as a game recreation of 70s martial arts action films, with a target release date in 2002 under the EA Sports label.

441449.overview:
The Keihin Kyuukou - Train Simulator Real: With Japanese citizens marching to the beat of a frenetic drum, time is of the essence when you're the man who takes salarymen, students and secretaries to their jobs and rounds every morning. Accelerate, decelerate and toot your horn whilst passing intersections to ward off potential passers. A follow up to The Yamate Line from earlier this year, Sony trains it's development skills on the competing Keihin bullet line in Japan. Big iron buffs may thrill to the use of live video footage in this game where complete routes have been transposed from video to PS2.

The game includes all train types including the latest Type 1000. The user can also choose their favorite cars and link them together for the game. The distinctive motor sound is also worthy of note. Lines included: Keihin Express Railway Main Line, Misakiguichi - Shinagawa and Kurihama Line, Haneda Airport - Keikyu Kamata.

441451.overview:
Keshikyun Puzzle Atori Mahiro VS Saitou- Elle VS Hakkai - Hakuouki Reimeiroku is a puzzle game that uses characters from some Idea Factory game series (like S.Y.K Shinsetsu Saiyuuki, Wand of Fortune, Hakouki, etc). The game didn't have an official release and was a promotional disc for the Girl Style series. There are 4 different characters to choose from.

The disc also contains a demo of Armen Noir and some video previews of other Idea Factory PS2 & PSP games.

441452.overview: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gihren no Yabou - Axis no Kyoui V is a Strategy game, developed by Bec and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2009. Is an expanded version of Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gihren no Yabou - Axis no Kyoui.

441458.overview:
Demonbane is a series by Nitroplus with mecha and Cthulhu Mythos elements. Beginning as an eroge visual novel for the PC, it was ported into a PlayStation 2 non-eroge remake, and spawned a sequel visual novel, a prequel novel, an anime television adaptation and a conversion to manga. An English version of the original Demonbane PC game has been released by JAST USA. The anime is streamed with English subtitles by CrunchyRoll.

Kishin Houkou Demonbane is the PlayStation 2 port of the original, published on July 1, 2004, the title loosely translates to "Roar of the Machine God Demonbane". Both the anime and the manga adaptations are based under this title, as well as using it in their adaptations. The game was also bundled with a one-episode OVA.

Mix equal parts of science, sorcery, and mechs and one comes up with a cauldron full of something similar to Demon Bane. The game is a set in a contemporary civilization but magic threads throughout the world along with technological wonders such as huge robots which fight for their respective masters. Based on our quick test drive this morning, the cast of characters is extensive and the storyline revolves around a secretive faction who uses magic to unleash a destructive force which ripples throughout a town and destroys a good chunk of it. To combat this underground cabal, a team is assembled which uses a powerful mech as their ace in the hole. Although the mechs on both sides do most of the fighting in the game, the cast of characters also wield magic for offensive and defensive use.

441475.overview: Kikou Heidan J-Phoenix is an Action game, developed by Shoeisha and published by Takara, which was released in Japan in 2001.

441480.overview: Armodyne is a sci-fi simulation role-playing game for the PlayStation 2. Released on February 22, 2007. It was developed by Omiya Soft, which worked on "Culdcept Series" and "FRONT MISSION SERIES GUN HAZARD". A strategy simulation game using a fictional humanoid weapon called "Armodyne".

441481.overview:
Battles takes place on terra as well as the fringes of outer space where weightless robots struggle to keep gatling-gun-fire on dashing bots and oncoming bruisers. To help in the firing game, a handy lock-on mode allows one to put a scope on an enemy and blast off a couple of cheap easy shots.

Somewhat similar to the Armored Core line of games, robot parts may be updated, bolted on and changed to improve attack or evade abilities.

441491.overview: Now that you have obtained your own Seaman egg, use the faithful recreation of Dr. Gasse's laboratory to follow in his footsteps, uncovering the secrets of the Seaman. When the Seaman egg hatches, the adventure begins...

442132.overview: Bonus disc bundled with Kamen Rider Hibiki. Features compatibility with the Taiko no Tatsujin Tatacon controller.

447962.overview: K-1 World Max 2005 is a fighting game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

448803.overview:
Mobile Suit Gundam follows the exploits of Amuro Ray and his friends and colleagues aboard the White Base, a flying fortress that serves as their home, as they engage in various missions against the Principality of Zeon. Half a century has passed since the world's population began migrating to massive orbiting space colonies. All is not well, however, as a group of colonies furthest from the planet proclaims itself the Principality of Zeon and declares war on Earth.

Half of the warring factions' populations have been destroyed and there appears to be no end in sight to this war between the Earth Federation and the Principality. An innocent civilian by the name of Amuro Ray is drawn into the conflict, and it's this young man, more specifically, his Gundam, that players control. Based upon the anime, gameplay in Mobile Suit Gundam is reminiscent of Armored Core 2, requiring players to pilot the robot-like Gundam through a number of missions ranging from guerilla attacks on enemy installations to defending a base against an onslaught of invaders.

Before each mission, players can choose to equip their Gundam with various weapons such as a long-range laser rifle and a Beam Saber for melee attacks. The GunTank and GunCannon can be called upon to provide backup in some of the game scenarios. Should the need arise in close-combat, the player can perform various slash attacks with the Beam Saber by pressing a combination of directions and buttons. Animated cut-scenes further the story and provide some insight into the actions and motivations of the many characters.

A Gallery mode contains information and 3D models of the various Mobile Suits encountered in the game as well as in-game cut-scenes and trailers for many of the home videos available in the cartoon series.

476820.overview:
Collection featuring three Maximum Impact games + Metal Slug 3D as an extra.

Game List:

* KOF MAXIMUM IMPACT (UNDUB) (North American version)
* KOF MAXIMUM IMPACT 2 (Japanese version, released in North America as KOF 2006)
* KOF MAXIMUM IMPACT REGULATION A (Japan-exclusive title)
* METAL SLUG 3D

480217.overview:
Kingdom Hearts II begins one year after the events of Kingdom Hearts and Chain of Memories. The game's setting is a collection of various levels (referred to in-game as "worlds") that the player progresses through. As in the first game, the player can travel to various Disney-based locales, along with original worlds specifically created for the series. While Disney-based worlds were primarily derived from the Disney animated features canon in the first game, Kingdom Hearts II introduces worlds that are based on live-action franchises: Pirates of the Caribbean or Tron. Each world varies in appearance and setting, depending on the Disney film on which it is based. The graphics of the world and characters are meant to resemble the artwork and style of the environments and characters from their respective Disney films.

Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix is an enhanced version of Kingdom Hearts II with additional content. Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix improvements include an English voice cast, tweaks in all difficulty modes and a new "Serious Mode" difficulty, new areas and redesigned navigation maps, new scenes from the Japanese manga, new boss battles against the mysterious Organization XIII, one of the fights that was a cutscene in the original being now playable, and all censored parts of the game no longer being censored.
